decision_conditions: The use hereby permitted shall cease on or before 4 August 2029. By that date the building shall be removed from the site and the land restored in accordance with a restoration and landscaping scheme which shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority no later than three months before the expiry of this permission. The approved scheme shall thereafter be implemented within the timescale specified in the approved details.Reason: The proposed building would not make full use of this site, which it is anticipated would be developed as part of a comprehensive development within the North Kingston Development Brief area in accordance with Council policies CS8 (Character, Design and Heritage) and DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The loading bay and vehicular access shall be provided and thereafter retained in accordance with drawing TP(01)05 and the approved swept-path analysis before the commercial use requiring deliveries commences. The loading bay shall be used solely for servicing and deliveries and shall not be used for staff, customer or general vehicle parking.Reason: In the interests of highway safety in accordance with Policy DM09 (Managing Vehicle Use for New Development) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The hard and soft landscaping approved under application reference 20/00907/CLC, including the details shown on drawing LN00426 L-501 Rev 02, shall be retained and maintained for the duration of this permission, except where expressly amended by the provision of the loading bay and associated access shown on drawing TP(01)05. The remaining landscaped areas shall not be used for any other purpose. Any tree, shrub or other planting which, during the lifetime of this permission, dies, is removed, becomes seriously damaged or diseased shall be replaced during the next available planting season with planting of a similar species and size, unless otherwise approved in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: In the interests of the character and appearance of the site, visual amenity and biodiversity, in accordance with Policies DM6 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.
description: Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to vary Conditions 1 (Approved plans), 2 (Period of Consent), 3 (Vehicle access) and 4 (Landscaping details) for Application Reference Number: 21/01427/FUL (Application under Section 73A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to carry out development without compliance with Condition 1 (Approved Plans) and Condition 2 (Period of Consent) of Planning Permission ref: 19/02199/FUL (Change of use from existing Sales and Marketing Suite (Sui Generis) serving the adjacent Queenshurst development to flexible commercial floorspace (A1/A2/B1/D1)) dated 03/04/2020. Changes sought to extend the time period for the planning permission to 2026 and for the omission of 2no. parking spaces on site.) dated 4/8/2021.  Variations sought to extend the temporary period until 2029; and to provide a single (on site) loading bay with associated access.
